public.app-category.utilities
Sanity uses Automation to perform Finder and Terminal actions only when you request them.
Sanity processes application audio locally for per-app volume controls and recordings you start. Audio is never retained by the mixer.
Sanity uses Bluetooth to read battery levels from connected peripherals.
Sanity records microphone audio only when you enable it for a screen recording.
Sanity accesses the camera only while its camera preview is open.
Sanity shows events you choose inside the notch calendar.
Sanity shows and completes reminders you choose inside the notch calendar.
Sanity accesses Downloads only for cleanup and organization actions you choose.
Sanity accesses the Desktop only when you choose it as a destination.
Sanity accesses Documents only when you choose it as a destination.
Sanity accesses network volumes only when you choose one for a file action.
Sanity accesses removable volumes only when you choose one for a file action.
Sanity is derived from GPL-licensed Vorssaint code.
